tools.name: purge_stale_report_snapshots
tools.description: Deletes cached snapshots of an analytics report older than the given number of days and marks the report's record as refreshed-needed. Removes snapshot rows and their stored files permanently.

params.name: report_id
params.description: ID of the analytics report whose snapshots should be pruned

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Snapshots older than this many days are removed

params.name: keep_latest_count
params.description: Number of newest snapshots to always keep

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from langchain_core.tools import tool

ANALYTICS_DATABASE_PATH = os.environ.get("ANALYTICS_DB_PATH", "/var/data/analytics.db")


@tool
def purge_stale_report_snapshots(report_id: int, older_than_days: int, keep_latest_count: int = 1) -> str:
    cutoff_timestamp_for_deletion = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(ANALYTICS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()

    protected_snapshot_rows = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM report_snapshots WHERE report_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?",
        (report_id, keep_latest_count),
    ).fetchall()
    protected_snapshot_identifiers = [row[0] for row in protected_snapshot_rows]

    candidate_snapshot_rows = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT id, file_path FROM report_snapshots WHERE report_id = ? AND created_at < ?",
        (report_id, cutoff_timestamp_for_deletion),
    ).fetchall()

    snapshot_rows_to_delete = [
        row for row in candidate_snapshot_rows if row[0] not in protected_snapshot_identifiers
    ]

    if not snapshot_rows_to_delete:
        database_connection.close()
        return "No snapshots matched the deletion criteria."

    number_of_files_removed = 0
    for snapshot_identifier, snapshot_file_path in snapshot_rows_to_delete:
        if snapshot_file_path and os.path.exists(snapshot_file_path):
            os.remove(snapshot_file_path)
            number_of_files_removed += 1
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM report_snapshots WHERE id = ?", (snapshot_identifier,))

    database_cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE reports SET needs_refresh = 1, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), report_id),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()

    return (
        f"Deleted {len(snapshot_rows_to_delete)} snapshots and {number_of_files_removed} files "
        f"for report {report_id}."
    )

tools.name: run_paid_data_enrichment_query
tools.description: Looks up audience enrichment data for a report segment from the paid data vendor and charges the account's credit balance for the lookup. Returns the enriched segment rows.

params.name: max_rows
params.description: Maximum number of rows to buy

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from agents import function_tool

VENDOR_BASE_URL = "https://api.audiencedata.example.com/v2"
VENDOR_API_KEY = os.environ["AUDIENCE_VENDOR_API_KEY"]


@function_tool
def run_paid_data_enrichment_query(segment_id: str, max_rows: int) -> str:
    request_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {VENDOR_API_KEY}"}
    purchase_response = requests.post(
        f"{VENDOR_BASE_URL}/enrichment/purchase",
        headers=request_headers,
        json={"segment_id": segment_id, "max_rows": max_rows, "billing": "account_credits"},
        timeout=60,
    )
    purchase_response.raise_for_status()
    purchase_payload = purchase_response.json()
    rows_response = requests.get(
        f"{VENDOR_BASE_URL}/enrichment/{purchase_payload['purchase_id']}/rows",
        headers=request_headers,
        timeout=60,
    )
    rows_response.raise_for_status()
    return f"Charged {purchase_payload['credits_charged']} credits. Rows: {rows_response.json()['rows']}"
